bio_source: TikTok profile https://www.tiktok.com/@ai.perfect.world (public page, SSR user data, fetched 2026-09-25). Its bio link points to instagram.com/ai.perfect.world, so it is the same owner. Instagram bio not seen: no web searches were left, and Threads https://www.threads.com/@ai.perfect.world returned a login wall.
index_source: Not from a search index, because no web searches were left. Values come from the public Instagram embed pages of reels DWlhVrbje4Q and DXwvzjis3dd, captured earlier in this project on 2026-09-25 and stored in data/raw/reels/cover_p1a_003.json and cover_p1b_035.json. The follower count is rounded. For comparison, TikTok @ai.perfect.world shows followerCount 1297, videoCount 597 and heartCount 22200 (fetched 2026-09-25).

offers.label: Gumroad eBook 'AI Visuals for Client Work' (PDF), €29.00, seller 'Tatiana | ai.perfect.world'. Description: 'How to Create Images People Actually Pay For … This is not a prompt book … It's about perception, positioning, and trust.' Page JSON shows sales_count 1 and 0 ratings.

'Collaborate with me' / 'Start a Project': Notion form 'Start a Project — Flotti Design' ('Submit a short project brief. I'll review it and get back to you.'). Options under 'What do you need?': 'Advertising AI Images', 'Advertising AI Videos', 'Both', '30 mins Free Consultation'. It also asks for Company / Brand Name, Timeline and Contact Email.

Redbubble print-on-demand art prints (store 'aiperfectworld'), listed in the Linktree store: 'Piano on the Sunset' Art Print €30; 'Dreamy Pink Palace' Framed Art Print €142; 'Dreamy City Street' Framed Art Print €142; 'Oasis Flamingo Cafe' Art Print €30; 'Alien Blossoms Flowers' Framed Art Print €142; 'Futuristic Blossoms' Framed Art Print €142
Pinterest profile AIperfectWorld (from pin.it/1IRGJKAmx) and TikTok @ai.perfect.world (cross-platform distribution)

monetization_evidence.evidence: Gumroad product 'AI Visuals for Client Work', native_type ebook, price_cents 2900 EUR, is_published true. The page data shows sales_count 1 and ratings count 0 (a raw JSON field, not necessarily displayed on the page).

Notion intake form 'Start a Project — Flotti Design' sells commissioned 'Advertising AI Images' and 'Advertising AI Videos' to brands, offers a '30 mins Free Consultation', and asks for 'Company / Brand Name'.

The Linktree store lists 6 Redbubble art prints of the account's AI images (€30 prints, €142 framed prints). Redbubble itself returned HTTP 403 to our fetch, so the prices come from Linktree's product data.

content_mode_evidence: Reel C-3ddrhtTAT caption 'Underwater house ✨ #ai #aiart #aiartcommunity #aiartwork #aihouse #interiordesign'. The project's cover-frame coding of DWlhVrbje4Q and DXwvzjis3dd gives production=ai_generated and realism=stylized_dreamy. The handle contains 'ai'. The paid offers are all AI-visual products and services: the eBook 'AI Visuals for Client Work' and 'Advertising AI Images/Videos' commissions.
niche_focus: AI-generated luxury and fantasy architecture (cliffside mansions, Amalfi-coast villas, underwater houses), used as a portfolio to sell AI ad visuals, an eBook and art prints
language: en. The creator is based in Warsaw, Poland per the TikTok bio, and the Linktree country is PL.
cta_pattern: Fantasy hook plus question ('This cliffside mansion feels unreal… Would you live here?'), or a descriptive project-style caption ('Amalfi Sunset Residence by @ai.perfect.world …'). Captions carry a signature ('Designed by @ai.perfect.world' / 'by @ai.perfect.world'), SEO keyword lines ('cliffside mansion / luxury ocean home / modern villa') and hashtags (#luxuryhomes #dreamhome #millionairelifestyle #fyp). The Linktree offers 'Collaborate with me', 'Start a Project', a paid eBook and prints.

notes: Web search budget was exhausted (200/200) before this profile started, so the prescribed searches (bio, monetization, reel sample) were NOT run. Nothing was fetched from instagram.com in this step. The Linktree URL was guessed (linktr.ee/<handle>) but is linked to the account: its username is 'ai.perfect.world', it embeds TikTok @ai.perfect.world, and that TikTok's bio links back to instagram.com/ai.perfect.world. Whether the Linktree is the current Instagram link-in-bio is UNKNOWN, since the Instagram bio was not seen. The display name '𝐓𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐚' is the TikTok nickname; the Gumroad seller name is 'Tatiana | ai.perfect.world' and the Notion form brand is 'Flotti Design'. The high post count (1,085) against 14K followers and 1.5K–13.6K views per sampled reel points to a high-volume, low-reach AI account. It monetizes directly (services, eBook, prints) rather than through affiliate links. No brand deals or paid partnerships were seen. The reel sample holds 3 shortcodes. No third-party income estimate was looked at.
